name: ERP 应收应付巡检团队
description: 应收应付与总账巡检团队：巡检岗逐科目核借贷平衡、余额重算与多币种汇率出处（只读），核对岗逐条定性差异并以 pending 提案回写，拍板岗持唯一确认门裁决落账或拒绝留痕；三岗错峰 06:12/06:19/06:26。装包后需手动启动，首回合只读巡检、不出结论。边界：工具面仅 fd-erp-ledger-mcp 的 8 件且逐岗经 resources.mcpTools 收窄；汇率无出处即拒绝（FX_UNSOURCED），不猜折算；资金执行（资金池/代收代付/分账）一律拒绝（二清红线），资金类科目只出现在只读核对里。
notes: 舰队模板 pack：装包后需手动启动（从模板实例化建队，新队默认暂停），首回合只读巡检、不出结论。三岗错峰 06:12 / 06:19 / 06:26；成员 target 解析到 erp-payables-fleet-roles 的三名岗位 preset；确认门只属拍板岗，逐岗工具面经 resources.mcpTools 收窄。persona 禁含花括号字面量与内部路径；fleetContext 只入 cadence.promptTemplate。状态：publish-ready 源清单，未上架（packId 未铸造）——待 roles 包先上架取得 packId 后回填依赖再铸。

en.name: ERP Receivables & Payables Inspection Team
en.description: Receivables, payables and general-ledger inspection team: the inspector checks debit/credit balance per account, recomputes balances and verifies FX rate provenance (read-only), the reconciler qualifies each difference and writes it back as a pending proposal, and the decider holds the sole confirmation gate to post or to reject with a recorded reason; posts stagger at 06:12 / 06:19 / 06:26. Install, then start manually; the first round is read-only. Boundaries: the tool face is the 8 tools of fd-erp-ledger-mcp narrowed per post via resources.mcpTools; an unsourced rate is refused (FX_UNSOURCED) and conversions are never guessed; fund execution is refused outright—fund accounts appear in read-only checks only.
en.notes: Fleet template pack: install, then start manually (new fleet is born paused); the first round is read-only inspection. Posts stagger at 06:12 / 06:19 / 06:26; the confirmation gate belongs to the decider only; tool faces narrowed via resources.mcpTools. Personas carry no literal braces; fleetContext only in cadence.promptTemplate. Status: publish-ready source, not yet listed (packId not minted).
